messages.中指編成で嫉妬完全共鳴6を作り、守備「お返し」から「オレのヘアクーポォオオオン!: A Middle commander and attacker that forms 6 Envy Absolute Resonance in a Middle team, then uses Payback to counter with MY HAIR COUPOOOOOOOOOOONS!!!! At 15 Vengeance Tattoo, unleash COMPLETE AND TOTAL EXTERMINATION!!
messages.反撃からS3(同期化Ⅳ): 守備「お返し」は、戦闘開始時に嫉妬完全共鳴の合計が6: **S3 from his counter (Uptie Ⅳ)**: If total Envy Absolute Resonance is 6 or more at Combat Start, the Defense skill Payback uses S3 when countering, up to 2 times per turn. At the same time, at Combat Start, it restores (Envy Resonance + 3) SP, up to 10, to the 3 Middle allies with the lowest SP, including himself (Uptie Ⅳ). He also gains Shield equal to 25% of HP lost.
messages.怨恨の刺青と「全員、処刑だ!!」: バトルパッシブ「末兄」(嫉妬×4・保有・同期: **Vengeance Tattoo and COMPLETE AND TOTAL EXTERMINATION!!**: Through the combat passive The Big Brother (4 Envy Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ), he gains 1 Vengeance Tattoo per Envy Resonance at Combat Start, up to 7. Defeating enemies with S3 grants 2 per enemy, up to 6 per turn. At 15 or more at Turn Start, one basic skill becomes COMPLETE AND TOTAL EXTERMINATION!! (3 Attack Weight, Uptie Ⅳ), and he spends 15 after the attack. He gains E.G.O resources of the type he has least, one per enemy defeated, up to 4.
messages.中指の耐久を底上げ: パッシブ「怨恨の刺青の共鳴」により、守備スキルを装着した中: **Raising the Middle's durability**: Through the passive Vengeance Tattoo Resonance, Middle allies with a Defense skill equipped take −20% damage from one-sided attacks that turn. At 4 or more Envy Resonance, the Middle Identities on both sides of him, and at 6 or more, all Middle Identities, are not staggered by damage while they still have counters available.
messages.味方が殴られたら追撃: 「末兄」により、敵が中指所属の人格を攻撃すると、その攻撃: **Follow-ups when allies are hit**: Through The Big Brother, when an enemy attacks a Middle Identity, he makes a one-sided attack on that attacker with Kicking, once per turn.
messages.S3の強化条件: 嫉妬共鳴2につき最終威力+1(最大3)。最も高い共鳴数だけ攻撃: **S3's bonus conditions**: +1 Final Power per 2 Envy Resonance, up to 3. Offense Level Up equal to the highest Resonance, up to 6. +1 Attack Weight at 6 or more Envy Absolute Resonance, and +1 more at 20 or more Book of Vengeance [Heathcliff]. Additional Blunt damage equal to Envy Resonance×5%, up to 30%.
messages.S2「後ろに注意!」: 戦闘開始時に、操作パネルの両隣の味方へ攻撃レベル増加2を: **S2 — Watch Your Back!**: At Combat Start, gives 2 Offense Level Up to the allies on both sides of him on the dashboard. It also inflicts debuffs such as 2 Paralyze and +3 Bleed Count.
messages.中指所属の人格をそろえて嫉妬完全共鳴6を作り、1ターン目に嫉妬×4を保有してパッ: Assemble Middle Identities to build 6 Envy Absolute Resonance, and on turn 1 hold 4 Envy to activate the passive. All S1s can be replaced with Defense skills for countering. The Defense skill itself becomes a counter S3, and early on it also handles allies' SP recovery. As long as Envy Resonance is maintained, Vengeance Tattoo builds naturally, letting him fire COMPLETE AND TOTAL EXTERMINATION!! regularly. Take painful attacks, and attacks that apply heavy Rupture or Sinking, with Clashes from S2 and S3, and counter weak attacks.
